tasks.goal: Research and add structured Lexicon grammar records for this semantic lesson family. These languages are globally Tier 1/2 planning priorities but remain lesson-level comparison_only until their actual records are complete.
per_language_acceptance: Identify the real words, particles, case markers, affixes, or constructions used for the semantic functions in this lesson; do not force a preposition model.
Add independent forms and rule records to grammar/for-equivalents.json with stable form_id/rule_id values and semantic_function_ids.
Document primary/authoritative sources where available and flag dialect/register/orthography differences rather than flattening them.
Include enough rule boundaries to support GrammarRuleBlock rendering without importing another language's rules.
Mark the grammar language record lesson_ready only when its structured data is internally coherent.
Remove the language from pending_full_support_research and add it to support_levels.full.language_tags only after validation passes.
Never promote a language merely because its global lesson tier is 1 or 2.

tasks.goal: Audit the 104 native-language comparison records. These are intentionally lightweight: representative forms/constructions plus one short native-language explanation, not full rule sets.
acceptance: Every record must describe this lesson's actual semantic territory, not repeat the generic lesson intro.

Check representative forms for purpose/intended use, recipient/beneficiary, cause/reason, direction/destination, duration/target time, route/means, exchange/support where those distinctions are natural in the language.
Do not require every language to cover every English sense; explicitly describe morphology, case, zero marking, or larger constructions when those are the natural strategy.
Review native-language wording for naturalness and script/orthography.
Promote generated -> audit_passed/community_verified/professional_verified only with evidence appropriate to the Gef trust ladder.

tasks.goal: Warn when a production translation/localization target is introduced outside the canonical programs.learnFromLanguages set (currently 104).
requirements: Derive the allowed set from Clickabl/gef-expo/registry/language-support.json; never copy the number or list into the automation.
Warning must identify the unexpected language tag and the file/path that introduced it.
Support explicit exceptions for UI-only localization, source/historical material, experimental/human-first work, and other centrally declared exception classes.
A representation/script/locale variant of an existing language must not be miscounted as a new learn-from language.
Coordinate with the central automation registry/action being built elsewhere; do not create a second automation framework for this lesson.
